017package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * A resolved, engine-neutral search tree (design §7) &mdash; the {@code ResolvedQuery.filter()} replacement for
023 * the earlier flat {@code Term}/{@code terms()} list.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * {@link QueryResolver} builds this tree from a request's raw {@code search} string: it parses the string with
027 * {@link SearchParser} into a {@link SearchItem} tree, then resolves every leaf's column (against the context's
028 * allow-list) and expression (with {@link SearchExpressionParser}, using that column's operator set), carrying the
029 * column's {@link SearchType} along for the engine to use. An empty search resolves to an empty {@link Filter.And}
030 * (design §7) &mdash; not <jk>null</jk> &mdash; so every engine can treat "no search" as just another tree to
031 * evaluate, one that matches every row.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Both engines walk this same shape: {@link InMemoryBeanQuerySession} evaluates it recursively against one row;
035 * {@code SqlSearchCompiler} (not linkable from here &mdash; it lives in the separate {@code juneau-beanquery-sql}
036 * module, which this one does not depend on) renders it to a parenthesized SQL boolean expression. Neither engine
037 * ever sees a raw request string or an unresolved column name.
038 *
039 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
040 * <p class='bjava'>
041 *    <jc>// ageExpr/nameExpr/emailExpr are already-resolved SearchExpressions, e.g. from SearchExpressionParser.parse()</jc>
042 *    <jc>// (age &gt; 21) AND (name CONTAINS "bob" OR email CONTAINS "bob")</jc>
043 *    Filter <jv>f</jv> = <jk>new</jk> Filter.And(List.<jsm>of</jsm>(
044 *       <jk>new</jk> Filter.Leaf(<js>"age"</js>, ageExpr, SearchType.<jsf>NUMERIC</jsf>),
045 *       <jk>new</jk> Filter.Or(List.<jsm>of</jsm>(
046 *          <jk>new</jk> Filter.Leaf(<js>"name"</js>, nameExpr, SearchType.<jsf>TEXT</jsf>),
047 *          <jk>new</jk> Filter.Leaf(<js>"email"</js>, emailExpr, SearchType.<jsf>TEXT</jsf>)))));
048 * </p>
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * Unlike the package-private {@link SearchItem} it mirrors, {@code Filter} is public: {@code SqlSearchCompiler}
052 * (above) lives in {@code juneau-beanquery-sql}, a separate module downstream of this one, and must be able to
053 * pattern-match over this tree directly.
054 *
055 * @since 10.0.0
056 */
057public sealed interface Filter {
058
059   /**
060    * One resolved {@code column=expression} leaf, with the column's {@link SearchType} carried alongside for the
061    * engine.
062    *
063    * <p>
064    * Note: {@link SearchExpression} has no value-based {@code equals}/{@code hashCode} of its own, so two
065    * {@code Leaf} instances built from separately-parsed-but-identical expression text are <b>not</b>
066    * {@link #equals(Object) equal} unless they share the same {@code expression} instance.
067    */
068   record Leaf(String column, SearchExpression expression, SearchType type) implements Filter {}
069
070   /** An AND of two or more (or, at the top level, zero) sub-filters.  An empty {@code And} matches every row. */
071   record And(List<Filter> items) implements Filter {
072      public And(List<Filter> items) {
073         this.items = List.copyOf(items);
074      }
075   }
076
077   /** An OR of two or more sub-filters. */
078   record Or(List<Filter> items) implements Filter {
079      public Or(List<Filter> items) {
080         this.items = List.copyOf(items);
081      }
082   }
083
084   /** The negation of exactly one sub-filter. */
085   record Not(Filter item) implements Filter {}
086}
